sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
ls -la /workspace /app 2>&1 | head -30
python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
d=open('/app/trunc.db','rb').read()
print("size",len(d))
# b-tree page header
ptype=d[0]
first_free=struct.unpack('>H',d[1:3])[0]
ncells=struct.unpack('>H',d[3:5])[0]
content_start=struct.unpack('>H',d[5:7])[0]
frag=d[7]
print(f"page_type={ptype} first_free={first_free} ncells={ncells} content_start={content_start:#x} frag={frag}")
ptrs=[struct.unpack('>H',d[8+2*i:10+2*i])[0] for i in range(ncells)]
print("cell ptrs:",[hex(p) for p in ptrs])

def varint(b,off):
    v=0
    for i in range(9):
        c=b[off+i]
        if i==8:
            v=(v<<8)|c; return v,off+9
        v=(v<<7)|(c&0x7f)
        if not (c&0x80): return v,off+i+1
    return v,off+9

def ser_type_len(t):
    if t==0: return 0
    if 1<=t<=4: return t
    if t==5: return 6
    if t==6: return 8
    if t==7: return 8
    if t in (8,9): return 0
    if t>=12: return (t-12)//2 if t%2==0 else (t-13)//2
    return 0

def decode(t,data,off):
    if t==0: return None,off
    if t==1: return struct.unpack('>b',data[off:off+1])[0],off+1
    if t==2: return struct.unpack('>h',data[off:off+2])[0],off+2
    if t==3: 
        v=int.from_bytes(data[off:off+3],'big',signed=True); return v,off+3
    if t==4: return struct.unpack('>i',data[off:off+4])[0],off+4
    if t==5: return int.from_bytes(data[off:off+6],'big',signed=True),off+6
    if t==6: return struct.unpack('>q',data[off:off+8])[0],off+8
    if t==7: return struct.unpack('>d',data[off:off+8])[0],off+8
    if t==8: return 0,off
    if t==9: return 1,off
    if t>=12:
        n=ser_type_len(t)
        raw=data[off:off+n]
        if t%2==0: return ('blob',raw),off+n
        else: return raw.decode('utf-8','replace'),off+n

rows=[]
for p in ptrs:
    off=p
    plen,off=varint(d,off)
    rowid,off=varint(d,off)
    payload=d[off:off+plen]
    hlen,q=varint(payload,0)
    types=[]
    while q<hlen:
        t,q=varint(payload,q)
        types.append(t)
    dt=hlen
    rec=[]
    for t in types:
        val,dt=decode(t,payload,dt)
        rec.append((t,val))
    rows.append((rowid,rec,plen,p))
    print(f"ptr={p:#06x} payload_len={plen} rowid={rowid} types={[t for t,_ in rec]} rec={rec}")

print()
print("=== decoded rows ===")
for rowid,rec,_,_ in rows:
    print(rowid, [v for _,v in rec])
PY

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import struct, sqlite3, os
page2=open('/app/trunc.db','rb').read()
assert len(page2)==4096

def varint(n):
    if n<=0x7f: return bytes([n])
    # simple big-endian base128
    out=[]
    while n:
        out.append(n & 0x7f); n >>= 7
    out=out[::-1]
    return bytes([b|0x80 for b in out[:-1]]+[out[-1]])

sql=b"CREATE TABLE t(a, word, value)"
payload = bytes([6]) + bytes([0x17,0x0f,0x0f,0x01,13+2*len(sql)]) + b"table"+b"t"+b"t"+bytes([2])+sql
assert payload[0]==6
cell = varint(len(payload)) + bytes([1]) + payload
content_start = 4096 - len(cell)
assert content_start < 4096

page1=bytearray(4096)
hdr=b"SQLite format 3\x00"
page1[0:16]=hdr
struct.pack_into('>H',page1,16,4096)
page1[18]=1; page1[19]=1; page1[20]=0
page1[21]=64; page1[22]=32; page1[23]=32
struct.pack_into('>I',page1,24,1)   # change counter
struct.pack_into('>I',page1,28,2)   # db size pages
struct.pack_into('>I',page1,32,0)   # freelist trunk
struct.pack_into('>I',page1,36,0)   # freelist count
struct.pack_into('>I',page1,40,1)   # schema cookie
struct.pack_into('>I',page1,44,4)   # schema format
struct.pack_into('>I',page1,48,0)   # cache size
struct.pack_into('>I',page1,52,2)   # largest root page
struct.pack_into('>I',page1,56,1)   # utf8
struct.pack_into('>I',page1,92,1)   # version valid for
struct.pack_into('>I',page1,96,3045000)
# btree header at 100
off=100
page1[off]=0x0d
struct.pack_into('>H',page1,off+1,0)      # freeblock
struct.pack_into('>H',page1,off+3,1)      # ncells
struct.pack_into('>H',page1,off+5,content_start)
page1[off+7]=0
struct.pack_into('>H',page1,off+8,content_start)  # cell pointer
page1[content_start:content_start+len(cell)]=cell

open('/tmp/rebuilt.db','wb').write(bytes(page1)+page2)
con=sqlite3.connect('/tmp/rebuilt.db')
print("tables:",con.execute("select name,sql from sqlite_master").fetchall())
print("schema:",con.execute("pragma table_info(t)").fetchall())
rows=con.execute("select rowid, word, value, typeof(value) from t order by rowid").fetchall()
for r in rows: print(r)
print("count:",con.execute("select count(*) from t").fetchone())
con.close()
PY
